unit: Unit 12: Everyday Life with Your Computer
title: Finding a map
drDigitalIntro:
A map website works like any other website: you type its address and it loads.
• The address for the most common one is maps.google.com.
• Once it loads you type a place name into its search box, the same way you search anywhere else.
• There is nothing to install. A map is just a web page.
• Practise typing the address here first — the address bar is unforgiving about spelling.

playgroundTask.instructions: Type the address of the map website into the address bar and press Enter.
playgroundTask.prompt: You want to look up directions. Go to maps.google.com.

drDigitalSuccess: That is all a map site is — an address you type, like any other.
drDigitalHint: Type it exactly: maps.google.com. No www, no https, and no spaces.
